verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that the canUseTool callback fires when Claude needs permission or asks clarifying questions via AskUserQuestion. The callback pauses execution until you return a response, and the decision goes back to the SDK. Streaming mode also documents interrupts and surfaced permission requests, and sessions can be resumed later with full context. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the approval flow, and explicit documentation of a durable pause that survives a process restart (persisting a pending approval and resuming it from a stored session).
